name: seatwifi
description: In-flight WiFi data: provider by flight, airline or tail number, measured speeds, and Starlink rollout status. Read-only, no account needed.

interface.longDescription: Check the WiFi on a flight before you fly. SeatWiFi tells you which provider (Starlink, Viasat, Gogo, Panasonic, Amazon Leo) is fitted to the aircraft on a flight, an airline or a tail number, whether the WiFi is free, how fast it is from measured speed tests, and how far each airline's Starlink rollout has progressed. Answers are predictions from fleet and ADS-B data, and each answer gives its confidence. Read-only. No account needed.
capabilities: Predict the WiFi provider on a flight number and date
Show WiFi provider, price and speed for an airline
Show Starlink rollout status by airline
Show the WiFi history of an aircraft tail number
defaultPrompt: Will UA1234 have Starlink WiFi tomorrow?
Which airlines have free Starlink WiFi?
Is the WiFi on Qatar Airways fast enough for video calls?

positive.description: Starlink odds for a flight number
positive.prompt: Will UA1234 have Starlink WiFi on its next flight?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the Starlink odds, the confidence level and a link to the SeatWiFi flight page

positive.description: WiFi provider and price for an airline
positive.prompt: What WiFi does Qatar Airways have, and is it free?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the providers, the free conditions and the cabins

positive.prompt: Which airlines are installing Starlink right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists airlines with an in-progress rollout and their progress

positive.description: Measured WiFi speeds for an airline
positive.prompt: Is the WiFi on Delta fast enough for a video call?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives measured speeds and says if they are enough for video calls

positive.description: WiFi history of an aircraft tail number
positive.prompt: What WiFi is fitted to aircraft N37502?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the provider history of that tail number

negative.description: Flight booking is out of scope. SeatWiFi cannot book flights
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to New York.

negative.description: Hotel WiFi is out of scope. SeatWiFi covers in-flight WiFi only
